description: This file defines classes and functions for creating and managing SSL server sockets within the Chromium networking code. It includes class declarations for SSLServerSocket and SSLServerContext, as well as factory functions for creating SSL server contexts with different key types.

classes.name: SSLServerSocket
classes.description: An interface for an SSL server socket that performs handshake operations asynchronously.

classes.name: SSLServerContext
classes.description: An interface for creating SSL server sockets over existing transport sockets, sharing session cache.

methods.name: SSLServerSocket::Handshake
methods.description: Performs the SSL handshake asynchronously, notifying the callback upon completion.

methods.name: SSLServerContext::CreateSSLServerSocket
methods.description: Creates an SSL server socket over a connected transport socket.

methods.name: CreateSSLServerContext
methods.description: Factory functions to create SSL server context objects with specified certificates and keys.
